name: secure-delivery
description: Turns a successful Stripe payment into a short-lived, signed download link served from a private R2 bucket.

ALLOWED_ORIGIN.description: REQUIRED. The exact origin of your live site, used for CORS. No trailing slash. Example: https://your-site.framer.website

TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES.description: How long each download/watch link stays valid, in minutes. 1440 = 24 hours.

SENDER_NAME.description: Display name shown as the sender on delivery emails (optional email feature).

SENDER_EMAIL.description: From-address for delivery emails (optional email feature).

TOKEN_SIGNING_SECRET.description: REQUIRED. Any long random string — signs your download tokens. Generate one at: https://generate-random.org/api-key-generator

BREVO_API_KEY.description: OPTIONAL. Brevo API key (xkeysib-…) to save visitor emails to your Brevo contacts automatically. Leave blank to skip.

FREE_PRODUCT_KEY.description: FREE template: the exact filename of your freebie in the R2 bucket (e.g. free-checklist.pdf). Must match the file you upload in R2 exactly.

FREE_PRODUCT_FILENAME.description: OPTIONAL. What the visitor's browser saves the file as (e.g. My-Free-Checklist.pdf). Defaults to FREE_PRODUCT_KEY if blank.

FREE_PRODUCT_NAME.description: OPTIONAL. A friendly display name for logs (e.g. Free Checklist).
